resting_hr_reference.description: How the astronaut's personal normal resting HR is calculated

resting_hr_change_flag.description: Flag if today's resting HR is this much above the personal reference

exercise_hr_zone.description: Expected HR range during aerobic exercise (70-85% of age-predicted max HR)
exercise_hr_zone.evidence: NASA-sourced: ISS aerobic exercise 30-40 min at 70-85% HRmax (NTRS 20090013286); 220-age formula (NTRS 20070023931)

hr_validity_window.description: A reading older than this is no longer treated as current

exercise_hr_above_zone.description: Flag if exercise HR exceeds the top of exercise_hr_zone
exercise_hr_above_zone.evidence: demo setting, based on the NASA zone upper limit
